refine_track: refine coarse track predictions using a fine feature network and fine track predictor
compute_score_fn: compute tracking confidence scores as standard deviation of 2D similarity heatmaps
extract_glimpse: extract image patches at specified offsets using bilinear grid sampling
run_refine_track_with_score: run refine_track on images with compute_score enabled to get refined tracks and scores
build_track_refinement_pipeline: build a track refinement pipeline using coarse predictions, fine_fnet, and fine_tracker modules
